title: Étude
program_note:
The musical concept of Étude is to show off how much the harp can do with as little as possible:  as little material, and as little apparent effort.

Étude was written for Grace Cloutier, while working on ...who write on clouds... for Grace to play at the 2000 Israel International Harp Contest.  Minor revisions were made in April, 2002, in October, 2012, and March, 2013.

David S. Lefkowitz

5 March, 2013

Los Angeles, California
